extDescription.message: Control video speed and quality in Chrome from Stream Deck, OpenDeck, TourBox or an Xbox controller. Talks only to this computer.

companionNote.message: VJster needs one free program on this computer: Fadester for OBS or the VJster plugin (for Stream Deck or OpenDeck), or Fadester Companion. Alone, this extension does nothing.

portNote.message: The port VJster uses in Fadester for OBS, the VJster plugin or Fadester Companion, on this computer only. Change it only if you changed it there.

idNote.message: To let only this extension connect, paste the id into the VJster settings of Fadester for OBS, the VJster plugin or Fadester Companion.

allSites.message: Control videos on every site, not only YouTube

allSitesNote.message: Speed only: quality needs YouTube's player. Chrome asks for permission to read and change every site.

statusLinkDown.message: Not connected. Start Stream Deck, OpenDeck or Fadester Companion on this computer. The port here must be the same as the port in the VJster settings.

statusBadPort.message: Use a whole number from 1024 to 65535; $DEFAULT$ is the default.

statusSaved.message: Saved. VJster now connects to port $PORT$.

statusNotAllowed.message: Not allowed: VJster stays on YouTube only.

statusAllSites.message: VJster now controls videos on every site. Reload open tabs to include them.

statusYouTubeOnly.message: VJster is back to YouTube only.

statusYouTubeOnlyKept.message: VJster is back to YouTube only; Chrome kept the all-sites permission, remove it on the extension's details page.
